nonblocking_findings.title: level-projection-and-progress-trend-contract.test.ts header still references 'Red tests' and 'Red signal'
nonblocking_findings.description: Line 1 says 'Task 1.2 contract Red tests' and line 21 says 'Red signal: each test below fails because the contract modules do not yet exist'. These are stale descriptions — the tests now pass (22 files / 301 tests / 0 failures). The stale-red-comments detector does not catch this because the em dash appears after '(Track 8 ...)' rather than immediately after the phase number, evading the /Phase\s+\d+\s+—\s+.*Red\s+tests?/i regex. Not a blocker — tests pass and contract is correct — but the header misleads readers.
